changeLog.summary: TEMPLATE VARIANTS ADDITION (this pass, orchestrator-agent@M01M03) — scoped as part of finishing M03/token-flow cohesion per the task brief, which explicitly authorized re-claiming M09 to touch its template data. Re-claimed M09 (was DONE/unclaimed) before touching any file. Added: (1) two nullable classification columns on MessageTemplate — severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW enum) and secretType (AWS_KEY/GITHUB_TOKEN/GENERIC_API_KEY/DB_CONNECTION_STRING enum), both additive/optional, defaulting to null on every existing and new row; (2) an includeAttributionLine boolean (default false, additive) plus a fixed, shared, non-editable ATTRIBUTION_LINE constant (packages/shared/src/template.ts) — 'If you'd like to support this project, visit: https://github.com/TODO-project-org/secretwatch' — appended to a rendered template body ONLY when that specific template's includeAttributionLine is true (never forced, never a per-template freeform value, never a wallet address/star-request/direct donation ask); (3) 8 seeded template variants (4 severity tone variants, 4 secret-type-specific variants — apps/web/prisma/seed.ts's seedTemplateVariants(), idempotent by name); (4) CRUD support for the 3 new fields in lib/messageTemplates.ts and both API routes (zod-validated enums); (5) UI: severity/secret-type selects + an attribution-line checkbox (with a fixed, non-editable preview of the line's exact text) added to the shared TemplateForm, and severity/secret-type/attribution-line Badges added to the Template Card in templates-client.tsx; (6) apps/worker/src/flagger.worker.ts now calls appendAttributionLine(renderedBody, template.includeAttributionLine) when rendering the real GitHub issue body — a one-line, backward-compatible change (no-op for every template with includeAttributionLine=false, which is every pre-existing/self-healed template). Did NOT wire severity/secretType into automatic template selection in the flagger worker — the worker still only ever selects the single isDefault:true template (getOrCreateDefaultTemplate) — that remains a documented follow-up, not implemented here, to avoid unscoped changes to M07's selection logic.

backend.note: ORIGINAL (2026-08-17 frontend pass): Backend (lib/messageTemplates.ts, app/api/message-templates/route.ts, app/api/message-templates/[id]/route.ts, packages/shared/src/template.ts) was already implemented and fully tested (48 passing tests) prior to this frontend pass; that pass did not modify any backend file. SUPERSEDED BY THE TEMPLATE-VARIANTS PASS BELOW: this module's backend was extended (not rewritten) later the same day to add severity/secretType/includeAttributionLine — see backendVariantsAddition.

backendVariantsAddition.summary: Added TemplateSeverity and TemplateSecretType Prisma enums; MessageTemplate.severity (nullable), MessageTemplate.secretType (nullable), MessageTemplate.includeAttributionLine (boolean, default false) — migration 20260817060000_add_message_template_variants, applied cleanly via `prisma migrate deploy`. lib/messageTemplates.ts's createMessageTemplate/updateMessageTemplate accept and persist the 3 new optional fields (never required, never breaking any existing caller); MessageTemplateSummary includes them; renderMessageTemplatePreview accepts an includeAttributionLine flag. packages/shared/src/template.ts exports ATTRIBUTION_LINE (fixed constant) and appendAttributionLine(body, include) (pure, no-op when include is falsy). Both API routes' zod schemas accept severity/secretType (enum, nullish) and includeAttributionLine (boolean, optional); PATCH's at-least-one-field refine was extended to include the 3 new fields. apps/web/prisma/seed.ts's new seedTemplateVariants() seeds 8 non-default templates (4 severity, 4 secret-type), idempotent by name, includeAttributionLine left false on every seeded row. apps/worker/src/flagger.worker.ts's runFlagForFinding now appends the attribution line to the real rendered issue body when the selected template's includeAttributionLine is true.

Mobile Header is not a separate component: like M02/M03/M04/M05/M06/M08, this module has no shared Mobile Header component. Unlike those modules' hand-built hamburger headers, this module's Mobile frame's hamburger/wordmark/avatar row is currently NOT implemented as a distinct mobile route/header — the shared components/layout/sidebar.tsx already hides at <md and components/layout/header.tsx renders at all sizes, so mobile users see the Header without a hamburger-triggered nav drawer. Functionally the templates list/cards/buttons are fully responsive (single-column, full-width New Template button, narrow cards) per the Mobile frame's content layout, but the hamburger-menu interaction itself was not wired since no shared mobile-nav-drawer pattern exists anywhere in the codebase yet to reuse (would require a cross-cutting change touching the shared Header/Sidebar, out of scope for a single-module frontend pass per CLAUDE.md section 4's shared-file caution). Flagging as a known follow-up, not a regression specific to this module.

No Delete action was built for individual templates, even though DELETE /api/message-templates/:id exists and is fully guarded (409 cannot_delete_default / cannot_delete_last_template). None of the 6 captured Figma frames (Default, Mobile, or either editor state) show a delete control on a template card or in the editor's Form Actions row, and CLAUDE.md's Figma-fidelity rules forbid inventing UI beyond what Figma specifies. If product intent is to expose delete in the UI, a follow-up Figma pass should add a Delete action (e.g. to the Template Card or Edit Template form) before frontend work adds a confirmation dialog for it.

LOW (QA): findUnsupportedVariables/renderTemplate silently pass through malformed tokens (unclosed '{{repo', hyphenated '{{re-po}}') without flagging or rendering them — cosmetic only, pre-existing pattern shape, not a regression introduced by M09.

LOW (security): deleteMessageTemplate's guard sequence (not-found -> cannot-delete-default -> cannot-delete-last) is not wrapped in a DB transaction, so two concurrent DELETE calls against the last two non-default templates could both pass the count check and leave zero templates (TOCTOU race). Admin-only, low likelihood, and self-healing via flagger.worker.ts's getOrCreateDefaultTemplate() (worst case is loss of custom copy, not a pipeline break or security bypass). Recommend wrapping in prisma.$transaction as a follow-up.

LOW (security): findUnsupportedVariables/renderTemplate match ASCII '{{'/'}}' only; a Unicode lookalike-brace token (e.g. fullwidth braces) is neither flagged as unsupported nor substituted, so it would appear inertly/verbatim in a posted issue. Cosmetic only, no injection or secret-exposure impact.

LOW (security, pre-existing M07 characteristic, not introduced by M09): Finding.repoFullName/filePath/matchedRule are attacker-influenceable (from scanned repos) and substituted unescaped into the GitHub issue body markdown; a crafted filename could cosmetically break rendering (e.g. an unmatched code fence). No code-execution/credential-leakage impact; GitHub's own renderer sanitizes markdown server-side. Candidate follow-up for a future M07 hardening pass (e.g. backtick-wrapping {{file}}/{{repo}}).
